title: Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse (Genesis) - Boss Battle
description:
A short, intense boss battle music from Castle of Illusion.

(Note: There're three games known as Castle of Illusion, including the Mega Drive game, the Master System/Game Gear game, and the remake of the Mega Drive game. This is from the original Mega Drive version.)
